export.title: Export chat
export.introGroup: Download this group as a JSON file with every message you can read, who sent it and when, replies and reactions.
export.introChat: Download this chat as a JSON file with every message you can read, who sent it and when, replies and reactions.
export.footerGroup: It includes messages from every member. Attachments are listed by name only; files, images and audio are not included. Review the file before sharing it with anyone or with an AI. Nothing is sent to an AI by this download.
export.footerChat: Attachments are listed by name only; files, images and audio are not included. Review the file before sharing it with anyone or with an AI. Nothing is sent to an AI by this download.

deleteContact.warningManage: This permanently deletes {name} for everyone, including all participants' chats, schedules, memories, and this contact's group messages and work.
deleteContact.warningMember: This removes your access and deletes your private chat, schedules, and contributed memories. Other participants keep the contact.
